records.literal_gloss: And said David to Michal, Before Yahweh, who chose me over your father and over all his house to appoint me ruler over [the] people of Yahweh, over Israel, and I will celebrate before Yahweh.

en.L: And David said to Michal, "Before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who chose me over your father and over all his house to appoint me ruler over the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, over Israel, I will celebrate before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: David said to Michal, "It was before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that I danced, before the one who chose me over your father and over all his family and appointed me ruler over Israel, the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will celebrate before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: David answered Michal, "I was dancing for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He chose me instead of your father or anyone in his family. He made me the leader of Israel, the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. So I will celebrate in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y dijo David a Mical: «Delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que me escogió en lugar de tu padre y de toda su casa para constituirme gobernante sobre el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sobre Israel, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me regocijaré.
es.B: David le dijo a Mical: «Fue delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que yo danzaba, delante de quien me escogió en lugar de tu padre y de toda su familia, y me nombró gobernante sobre Israel, el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Celebraré delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: David le respondió a Mical: «Yo bailaba para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Él me escogió a mí en lugar de tu padre o de cualquiera de su familia. Me hizo líder de Israel, el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Por eso celebraré delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et David dit à Mikal : « Devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui m’a choisi de préférence à ton père et à toute sa maison pour m’établir chef sur le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sur Israël, je m’égaierai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: David répondit à Mikal : « C’est devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que j’ai dansé, devant celui qui m’a choisi de préférence à ton père et à toute sa famille pour m’établir chef d’Israël, le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Je me réjouirai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: David a répondu à Mikal : « C’est pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que je dansais. Il m’a choisi à la place de ton père et de toute sa famille. Il a fait de moi le chef d’Israël, le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors je ferai la fête devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

vi.R: Đa-vít trả lời Mi-canh: "Ta nhảy múa là để tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ngài đã chọn ta thay vì cha bà hay bất cứ ai trong gia đình người. Ngài đã lập ta làm người lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vậy ta sẽ còn vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: Before the LORD ...: it was before the LORD that I did it
alternatives: Before the LORD I danced; blessed be the LORD, who chose me (the Greek)
decisions.reason: David begins "Before the LORD" and does not finish the thought, then ends with "I will celebrate before the LORD". The sense is: what I did, I did before the LORD. The Greek fills it out: "Before the LORD I danced; blessed be the LORD, who chose me ...". The Hebrew is followed here.

decisions.choice: who chose me over your father and all his house
decisions.reason: David reminds Saul's daughter that the LORD rejected Saul and chose David in his place (1 Samuel 13:13-14; 15:28; 16:1). His dancing was worship of the God who made him king, not a show for others.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one the LORD appoints to lead his people
decisions.reason: The word was used when the LORD chose a man after his own heart to lead his people (1 Samuel 13:14; 25:30).

decisions.choice: celebrate
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 5: to make merry, with music and dance.

decisions.choice: It was before the LORD that I danced; I was dancing for the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "I danced" so that David's unfinished opening reads as a sentence (see m1).

decisions.choice: leader
decisions.reason: Readable says "leader" for the word Literal and Balanced render "ruler", as in these books.

decisions.choice: David says "ta" and "bà" to Michal in this quarrel
decisions.reason: The Genesis note sets "em" and "anh" between husband and wife at Balanced and Readable; here David answers his wife's contempt as king, and the cold "ta" and "bà" carry the break between them that verse 23 seals.

records.literal_gloss: And I will be lightly esteemed still more than this, and I will be low in my eyes; and with the maidservants of whom you have spoken, with them I will be honored.

en.L: And I will be more lightly esteemed still than this, and I will be low in my [own] eyes; but with the slave girls of whom you have spoken, with them I will be honored."
en.B: I will make myself even more undignified than this, and I will be humble in my own eyes. But by the servant girls you spoke of, by them I will be held in honor."
en.R: I am willing to look even more foolish than this and to be humble in my own eyes. But those servant girls you talked about will honor me."

es.L: Y seré tenido en menos todavía que esto, y seré bajo a mis [propios] ojos; pero con las esclavas de quienes has hablado, con ellas seré honrado».
es.B: Me rebajaré todavía más que esto, y seré humilde a mis propios ojos. Pero esas criadas de las que hablaste, ellas me tendrán en honra».
es.R: Estoy dispuesto a parecer todavía más tonto que esto y a ser humilde a mis propios ojos. Pero esas criadas de las que hablaste me honrarán».

fr.L: Et je serai encore plus méprisable que cela, et je serai bas à mes [propres] yeux ; mais auprès des servantes dont tu as parlé, auprès d’elles, je serai honoré. »
fr.B: Je m’abaisserai encore plus que cela, et je serai humble à mes propres yeux. Mais ces servantes dont tu parles, elles m’honoreront. »
fr.R: Je suis prêt à paraître encore plus ridicule et à être humble à mes propres yeux. Mais ces servantes dont tu as parlé, elles, m’honoreront. »

vi.L: Ta sẽ còn bị coi rẻ hơn thế nữa, và ta sẽ thấp hèn trong mắt [chính] mình; nhưng với những tớ gái mà bà đã nói, với họ ta sẽ được tôn trọng."
vi.B: Ta sẽ còn hạ mình hơn thế nữa, và tự xem mình là thấp hèn. Nhưng chính những tớ gái bà đã nói đến sẽ tôn trọng ta."
vi.R: Ta sẵn lòng để bị xem là còn khờ dại hơn thế nữa, và tự hạ mình xuống. Nhưng chính những tớ gái bà nói đến sẽ kính trọng ta."

decisions.choice: lightly esteemed ... honored: "light" set against "heavy"
decisions.reason: The verb for "be lightly esteemed" comes from a word for "light, of little weight"; the word for "honor" comes from a word for "heavy, weighty". David answers Michal's mocking "honored" (verse 20): he is ready to be thought of little weight, and it is among the lowly that he will have honor.

decisions.choice: in my own eyes: as the Hebrew text reads
decisions.reason: The Greek reads "in your eyes", which would mean "I will be low in your sight". The Hebrew has David say he will be humble in his own sight.

decisions.choice: low ... honored: the LORD lifts the lowly
decisions.reason: The words echo Hannah's song: the LORD brings low and lifts up, and gives the poor a seat of honor (1 Samuel 2:7-8).

decisions.choice: servant girls
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

decisions.choice: Michal had no child: Saul's line would not continue through David's house
decisions.reason: The writer does not say whether this was the LORD's judgment or because David no longer lived with her as a husband. Either way, no child of Saul's daughter would sit on David's throne. (In 21:8 the Hebrew names "Michal" as the mother of five sons, but that is probably an error for her sister Merab, as 1 Samuel 18:19 shows.)
